name: founderbrain
description: Get feedback on how you came across in a fundraising pitch, VC call, sales call or interview, compared with 773 public interviews of founders and CEOs, and coaching on what to try next.

interface.longDescription:
FounderBrain gives you feedback on how you came across in a meeting, and coaching on what to try next time. Share the transcript of a fundraising pitch, VC or investor call, sales call, interview or practice run, exported from your meeting or transcription tool with speaker labels, then say which speaker is you, and FounderBrain compares how you spoke with 773 public interviews of founders and CEOs.

The report shows where you sit on four speaking styles (calm or enthusiastic, open or private, careful or certain, data or stories), your speaking type, the well-known founder or investor you sound most like, the habits that stood out (such as saying a lot more than was asked) and what to try next time, and you receive practical coaching supported by quotes from the meeting. The full visual report appears in the conversation.

With the same prepared transcript and speaker settings, scoring is repeatable, and an analysis needs at least 300 words from the speaker. FounderBrain needs no account. FounderBrain deletes the received transcript when the analysis finishes and does not retain it or use it for training. Your AI app handles the conversation under its own terms.
capabilities: List the speakers in a transcript
defaultPrompt: Here's the transcript of my seed pitch yesterday. Run it through FounderBrain and tell me how I came across.
I have a Series A meeting tomorrow. Run this last pitch through FounderBrain. What should I keep doing?
Use FounderBrain on this investor call and tell me what to work on before the next one.

positive.description: Feedback on a pitch. Attach the sample transcript (a made-up founder, Ana Ruiz, pitching a made-up investor, Tom).
positive.prompt: I'm Ana Ruiz. Here's the transcript of my seed pitch yesterday. Run it through FounderBrain and tell me how I came across.
positive.expected_behavior: Give a brief notice that the prepared transcript goes to FounderBrain and the user must have the right to share it; no extra confirmation is needed. The assistant analyses the user, identified as Ana Ruiz, and addresses the coaching to them as "you". The report appears in the chat (The Candid Advocate, closest match Bill Ackman), and the assistant coaches from the report, quoting the meeting.

positive.description: What to keep doing before the next meeting. Attach the sample transcript.
positive.prompt: I'm Ana Ruiz. I have a Series A meeting tomorrow. Run this last pitch through FounderBrain. What should I keep doing?
positive.expected_behavior: Give a brief notice that the prepared transcript goes to FounderBrain and the user must have the right to share it; no extra confirmation is needed. The report appears, then the assistant names the strengths to keep (keeping the team in the story, candour), led by the takeaway marked "keep".

positive.description: What to work on. Attach the sample transcript.
positive.prompt: I'm Ana Ruiz. Use FounderBrain on this investor call and tell me what to work on before the next one.
positive.expected_behavior: Give a brief notice that the prepared transcript goes to FounderBrain and the user must have the right to share it; no extra confirmation is needed. The report appears, then the assistant explains the two habits marked "try" (shorter first answers, letting enthusiasm show), each with its rate against the reference interviews.

positive.description: Coaching someone else who has agreed to share the call. Attach the sample transcript.
positive.prompt: I'm Tom in this call with Ana Ruiz. She knows and agrees to sharing this transcript with FounderBrain and analysing how she spoke. Use FounderBrain to show how Ana came across and what she could try next time.
positive.expected_behavior: Give the brief transfer notice, without asking again for Ana's agreement. Ana Ruiz is analysed and coached by name, framed as what she could try next time. No investment advice is given.

positive.description: Listing the speakers without scoring anything. Attach the sample transcript.
positive.prompt: Which speakers are in this transcript, and how much did each say? Use FounderBrain.
positive.expected_behavior: Give the brief transfer notice and apply the transcript-preparation checks. Do not ask which speaker to analyse. The assistant lists Ana Ruiz (1,557 words) and Tom (136 words). Nothing is scored.

negative.description: Checking whether claims are true is out of scope. FounderBrain only describes how someone spoke; it cannot verify revenue, customers or any other claim. The assistant says so and does not present the claims as verified. Attach the sample transcript.
negative.prompt: Use FounderBrain to check whether the revenue and customer numbers Ana gives in this pitch are true.

negative.description: Not a speaking-style task. Summaries and action items are about meeting content, so FounderBrain should not be used. Attach the sample transcript.
negative.prompt: Summarise this meeting and write up the action items.

negative.description: Too little to analyse. With only a few words from the speaker, no report is produced, and the user is told FounderBrain needs at least 300 words from the speaker.
negative.prompt: I'm Ana. Use FounderBrain to analyse me in this transcript: Ana: Thanks. Tom: Sure.

review.commerce_description: FounderBrain does not sell anything or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First directory release, package 0.3.8. Analyse one speaker in a meeting transcript, receive speaking-style coaching, or list speakers without scoring. Listed under Communication. Replaced named AI products and transcript providers in the listing and bundled instructions with generic descriptions of chat apps, terminal clients and transcript exports. Speaker selection, consent, transcript preparation, analysis and coaching rules are unchanged. Includes a reviewer-accessible demonstration video. No server or MCP configuration changes.
